purpose: bind the final all-pass report to the exact inventory bytes checked; record verifier provenance; reconcile archive digests against the bound Cargo.lock; state all_pass scope

verifier.note: the copy executed from tmp/ is byte-identical to the committed tools/ copy
verifier.toolchain: python 3.12, linux x86_64; crate archives fetched from static.crates.io

archive_digest_reconciliation.explanation: the submitted inventory omits the crates metadata section, so the verifier recorded crate_sha256_expected null and crate_sha256_match false for the first file of each package; subsequent files of the same package recorded match true via the cached archive. This is a metadata omission in the inventory, not an archive digest mismatch.

all_pass_scope: all_pass in the final report aggregates region boundary checks, symbol containment, and per-file hash comparisons only. Archive-to-lockfile comparisons did not participate in the aggregate because expected values were null. The reconciliation above independently establishes archive-to-lockfile equality for all three affected packages.
